definitions.gloss: to rest, to give rest to

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{休|やす}める。
⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{休|やす}めたい。
examples.english: I'm tired, so I want to rest my body a bit.

notes:
{休|やす}める is an ichidan verb meaning to rest or give rest to something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {休|やす}む (intransitive - to rest, take a break)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体|からだ}を{休|やす}める: to rest one's body
- {目|め}を{休|やす}める: to rest one's eyes
- {心|こころ}を{休|やす}める: to ease one's mind
- {足|あし}を{休|やす}める: to rest one's feet

EXPRESSIONS:
- {羽|はね}を{休|やす}める: to take a breather (lit. rest one's wings)
- {手|て}を{休|やす}める: to stop working temporarily

USAGE NOTE:
Used when giving rest to a specific body part or the body as a whole, as opposed to {休|やす}む which is more general (to take a day off, to rest).
